operator_grant.verbatim: I will be aways for hours so you will be taking over the experiments continuously and automatically for hours, and GPU will be available for long-running, large targeted fine tuning and reasoning enhance experiment whenever you needed it.
what_it_plainly_authorizes: targeted fine-tuning at scale on the local host
autonomous continuation across hours without per-step approval
what_it_does_not_mention_and_stays_close: cloud GPU or any paid service
production registry edit or model replacement
human data-review sign-off (cannot be granted by an availability statement)
on-policy RL rollouts (GOAL section 8 requires a verifier adversarial pass and a readiness gate first)

numeric_envelope_provenance: The operator supplied authority and availability, NOT numbers. The limits below are AGENT-INSTANTIATED from that grant, sized to the measured local host, and are binding on this agent. They are not a quotation of an operator-specified figure. GOAL section 1 requires numeric limits to exist before model execution; this record creates them.
scope_opened: RRP-001-QUAL: local zero-update source/shape/parity qualification on real Supa 1.7 weights
RRP-001-MICROFIT: the frozen 32-world engineering microfit per MICROFIT_PLAN.json
RRP-001-LADDER-A/B/C: the sequential SFT ablation ladder of GOAL section 7, subject to its own pre-registration and to the data-review constraint below
scope_still_closed: ladder arm D (verifiable RL) and any on-policy rollout
dense export, adapter merge, quantization, registry edit, release

measured_host_at_authorization.foreign_python_processes_seen: 4 harness/helper processes, each <=0.02 GiB working set, not model jobs, not owned by this agent, NOT to be terminated

guards_unchanged_and_non_negotiable.gpu_lease: cooperative file lock must be acquired; a stale lock is never assumed dead without process evidence
guards_unchanged_and_non_negotiable.watchdog: required; the historical no-watchdog --_worker bypass is forbidden
guards_unchanged_and_non_negotiable.on_breach: fail closed, journal the breach, do not lower the guard to force a run
never: terminate another user's or agent's processes

human_data_review_status.consequence_accepted: The qualification, microfit and resume verification are ENGINEERING evidence only and make no data-quality or model-quality claim, so they proceed. Any ladder arm whose DEV/retention comparison is offered as a quality claim requires the operator to sign REVIEW_PACKET.md first. This agent will not self-certify that review, and will report ladder results as review-pending if it runs them before sign-off.

stop_conditions: any single limit above is reached
a resource guard fails and cannot be satisfied without lowering it
a safety or validity failure in the instrument
